Alice M.: heads-up: ArgoCD failed the inference-runtime helm chart sync in eu-central-1-prod. looks like CRD conversion webhook timed out and a pre-upgrade job is stuck Pending. anyone on call?
Ben (infra): on it. can you paste the Argo error?
Alice M.: here — Argo reported: 
```
Error: helm upgrade failed: timed out waiting for the CRD conversion webhook "gpupools.apps.redwood.ai" to respond
pre-install hook gpupool-preflight-check job is Pending: PodAffinity/NodeAffinity mismatch -> 0 nodes match
```
Carla S.: that preflight job uses a PVC that is bound to zone-a (volumeClaimTemplates with topologyKey). I think Terraform didn't create the gpu-nodepool in zone-a due to a quota error earlier today — I saw a failed apply in the infra pipeline.
Dave-R: confirmed: terraform apply for eu-central-1-gpu-np returned 403 QuotaExceeded at 10:12. autoscaling group never got GPUs, so scheduler reports 0 GPU capacity in zone-a.
Ben (infra): ok, two parallel tracks: (1) get the webhook responding so CRD conversion doesn't block other clusters, (2) unblock the preflight job / or skip it to let rollout continue. which is higher risk?
Carla S.: conversion webhook is critical — it's served by deployment gpupool-webhook in kube-system. pods show CrashLoopBackOff on startup because cert-manager didn't renew the webhook cert (the cert secret is empty). quick fix might be to restart cert-manager's job or re-issue the cert.
Alice M.: we need a quick unstick in prod. can we patch the helm chart to skip the preflight hook temporarily so Argo can finish the sync? or should we rollback?
Ben (infra): rollback is cleaner but will also hit the same preflight if chart hooks run on rollback. Argo tries a rollback to the previous revision but helm hooks still execute depending on policy. We can manually annotate the release to skip hooks, or use `helm upgrade --install --disable-hooks` but ArgoCD doesn't pass that by default.
Dave-R: quick commands I'd run: 
```
# check webhook logs
kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l app=gpupool-webhook
kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/gpupool-webhook -c webhook

# check preflight job
kubectl -n inference get job gpupool-preflight-check -o yaml
kubectl -n inference get pods -l job-name=gpupool-preflight-check
```
Carla S.: I can try to create a short-lived patch that deletes the preflight job in the cluster to let Argo proceed, but that's a bit gross. prefer: scale the nodepool in zone-a to 1 so PVC can bind and job can schedule. I'll open a quick Terraform change to bump desired_count=1 for eu-central-1-gpu-np.
Ben (infra): also I'll create a temporary Service to route webhook traffic to a healthy webhook pod in a different AZ as a stopgap, and rotate the cert secret for gpupool-webhook.
argocd-bot: Application inference-runtime-prod: sync failed: helm upgrade error: conversion webhook timeout
Alice M.: Carla, how long for the TF change?
Carla S.: creating PR now, it's a one-line variable bump. if approvers + apply go green we should have nodes in ~10-15 mins.
Ben (infra): I'm patching the webhook secret now: `kubectl -n kube-system delete secret gpupool-webhook-cert; kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/cert-manager` — will monitor logs.
Dave-R: FYI, if we bring nodes up we still risk the hook re-running and failing if the conversion webhook still misbehaves. sequence: ensure webhook healthy -> ensure nodes exist -> Argo re-sync -> verify CRD conversions succeed.
Alice M.: infra-bot, can you create a temporary incident channel for followups?
infra-bot: created #incident/eu-central-gpupool-197654 patch: https://redwood.incident/197654
Carla S.: PR merged and Terraform apply started. cloud API shows instance provisioning in zone-a.
Ben (infra): webhook pod now Ready (logs show cert reissued). running quick smoke: `kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations | grep gpupool` -> found. hitting conversion endpoint returns 200.
Dave-R: job pods are Pending still but now they can mount PVC once k8s sees nodes. waiting for kubelet registration.
Alice M.: ArgoCD triggered another sync attempt automatically?
argocd-bot: Application inference-runtime-prod: auto-sync initiated (diff detected)
Alice M.: watching the Argo sync — it just failed again but with a different message: `job gpupool-preflight-check failed: pod failed scheduling: PersistentVolumeClaim not yet bound`
Carla S.: PVC is bound now, pod moved to Running, preflight job completed successfully.
Ben (infra): Argo sync reattempt in progress...
argocd-bot: Application inference-runtime-prod: sync completed. health: Healthy
Alice M.: ✅ sync completed and chart deployed. thanks all.
Carla S.: follow-up items: 1) fix terraform pipeline to fail louder and auto-notify when gpu quota prevents nodepool creation, 2) make preflight hook tolerant of PVC binding delays (add retries / backoff), 3) add alert when gpupool-webhook cert is close to expiry.
Ben (infra): I'll open infra tickets for cert rotation automation and webhook HA.
Dave-R: log the rollout notes: `1976543210 - helm upgrade blocked by CRD conversion webhook timeout + TF drift (nodepool not created) -> patched cert, scaled nodepool, retried sync`
Alice M.: closing thread. if anything regresses ping me. :thumbsup:
